notes.subject: buru
notes.rationale: לחם ye buru/dumuni ye; n'a bɛɛ bɛ fɔ 'dumuni' ye, buru de ye לחם ka daɲɛ tilennen ye

notes.subject: hesed
notes.rationale: חסד: hesed tɛ bɔ a yɛrɛ la (sariya-matarafali); cogo min bɛ sɔn — kanuya, ɲumanya, makari — u kelen-kelen dɔgɔ

notes.subject: a ka hesed bɛ taa
notes.rationale: Heburukan tɛ copula 'bɛ' seben, Bamanankan ka kan ka a di

notes.subject: jama
notes.rationale: סalmu in bɛ jama wele kuma in kɔnɔ, a bɛ u laso 'Yawe kirali bɛ taa kɔlɔkɔ'

translation: A bɛ buru di sogo bɛɛ ma, sabu a ka hesed bɛ taa kɔlɔkɔ.
